verdict.rationale: The evidence covers the single-WebSocket architecture, telephony bridging, regional endpoints and reusable configs. Nothing documents concurrency limits, rate limits, or self-serve scaling to many simultaneous calls. Concurrency and scale are a fair axis for a hosted voice agent API, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented concurrency limits and scale to many simultaneous calls without manual capacity begging
